mapper.select: SELECT j.id, j.title, CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(j.recruitmentLimit, '0'), '[^0-9]', '') AS UNSIGNED) AS needed, COUNT(ja.id) AS hired, CONCAT( ROUND( COUNT(ja.id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(j.recruitmentLimit, '0'), '[^0-9]', '') AS UNSIGNED), 0), 1 ), '%' ) AS rate FROM job j LEFT JOIN job_application ja ON ja.job_id = j.id AND ja.status = 'accepted' WHERE j.userId = #{merchantId} GROUP BY j.id

SELECT a.attendance_status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM attendance a JOIN work_assignment wa ON wa.id = a.work_assignment_id JOIN job j ON j.id = wa.job_id WHERE j.userId = #{merchantId} GROUP BY a.attendance_status

SELECT DATE(a.check_in_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM attendance a JOIN work_assignment wa ON wa.id = a.work_assignment_id JOIN job j ON j.id = wa.job_id WHERE j.userId = #{merchantId} AND a.check_in_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(a.check_in_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT u.name, SUM(a.work_minutes) AS total_minutes FROM attendance a JOIN work_assignment wa ON wa.id = a.work_assignment_id JOIN job j ON j.id = wa.job_id JOIN user u ON u.id = a.student_id WHERE j.userId = #{merchantId} GROUP BY a.student_id ORDER BY total_minutes DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, credit_after AS credit FROM credit_record WHERE user_id = #{studentId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY created_at

SELECT DATE(wa.work_date) AS date, SUM(a.work_minutes) AS minutes FROM attendance a JOIN work_assignment wa ON wa.id = a.work_assignment_id WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND wa.work_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(wa.work_date) ORDER BY date
SELECT IFNULL(j.remunerationType, '其他') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM work_assignment wa JOIN job j ON j.id = wa.job_id WHERE wa.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY j.remunerationType
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
SELECT identity AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM user GROUP BY identity
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM job GROUP BY status
SELECT attendance_status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM attendance GROUP BY attendance_status

SELECT t.record_date as date, cr.credit_after as credit FROM ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS record_date, MAX(created_at) AS max_time FROM credit_record WHERE user_id = #{merchantId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) t INNER JOIN credit_record cr ON cr.user_id = #{merchantId} AND cr.created_at = t.max_time ORDER BY t.record_date
